events.factual_description: Roulette presents Interpretations: Ursel Schlicht // Critical Response on Thursday, October 22, 2026 at 8:00 PM, with doors at 7:00 PM. The program pairs a solo performance by pianist Ursel Schlicht with a set by Critical Response featuring Jason Kao Hwang on violin and viola, Anders Nilsson on guitar, and Michael T.A. Thompson on drums and percussion. The concert is presented by Interpretations in partnership with Roulette as part of the series' 37th season. Roulette lists $20 advance and door admission and a $15 student/senior price with qualifying ID. A free livestream is scheduled for 8:00 PM and is to be archived afterward. Roulette's official contact page verifies the venue's physical address as 509 Atlantic Avenue, Brooklyn, New York 11217.

en.why_it_matters: The pairing is the point. One set leaves Ursel Schlicht alone at the piano; the other turns Jason Kao Hwang's violin and viola, Anders Nilsson's guitar, and Michael T.A. Thompson's percussion into a three-way improvising system where timbre can shift as quickly as form. Inside the long-running Interpretations series, the night puts two different ways of building music in real time into direct conversation.
en.trip_verdict: If you're already in New York on October 22, this is a strong Brooklyn night to catch, especially when the experimental-improvisation thread is active. From the DMV, pair it with another New York reason rather than make a dedicated trip for this program alone.

es.why_it_matters: El atractivo está en el contraste. Un set deja a Ursel Schlicht sola al piano; el otro convierte el violín y la viola de Jason Kao Hwang, la guitarra de Anders Nilsson y la percusión de Michael T.A. Thompson en un sistema de improvisación a tres bandas donde el timbre puede cambiar tan rápido como la forma. Dentro de la larga historia de Interpretations, la noche pone frente a frente dos maneras distintas de construir música en tiempo real.
es.trip_verdict: Si ya estás en Nueva York el 22 de octubre, es una muy buena noche para caer a Brooklyn, sobre todo si anda activo el hilo de improvisación experimental. Desde el DMV, la combinaría con otra razón para estar en Nueva York en vez de hacer el viaje exclusivamente por este programa.
